description: This file defines various Grain classes and a base class used for testing placement strategies within the Orleans distributed actor framework. It includes grains with different placement strategies, methods for fetching endpoints and runtime IDs, and utility functions for managing grain activation and cluster statistics.

classes.name: PlacementTestGrainBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for placement test grains, providing common methods and state for testing placement strategies.

classes.name: RandomPlacementTestGrain
classes.description: Grain class with RandomPlacement strategy, inherits from PlacementTestGrainBase.

classes.name: PreferLocalPlacementTestGrain
classes.description: Grain class with PreferLocalPlacement strategy, inherits from PlacementTestGrainBase.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerPlacementTestGrain
classes.description: Grain with StatelessWorker placement strategy (1 worker), inherits from PlacementTestGrainBase.

classes.name: OtherStatelessWorkerPlacementTestGrain
classes.description: Grain with StatelessWorker placement strategy (2 workers), inherits from PlacementTestGrainBase.

classes.name: ActivationCountBasedPlacementTestGrain
classes.description: Grain with ActivationCountBasedPlacement strategy, inherits from PlacementTestGrainBase.

classes.name: DefaultPlacementGrain
classes.description: Standard Grain that exposes its default placement strategy.

classes.name: LocalContentGrain
classes.description: Grain that stores and provides local silo identity content, demonstrating local activation and deactivation.

classes.name: TestContentGrain
classes.description: Grain that retrieves content from the LocalContentGrain, used for testing content fetching.

methods.name: GetEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the endpoint of the current grain's silo.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Returns the runtime identity string of the silo.

methods.name: GetActivationId
methods.description: Returns the unique activation ID of this grain instance.

methods.name: Nop
methods.description: A no-operation method to ensure grain instantiation.

methods.name: StartLocalGrains
methods.description: Ensures a list of grain references are instantiated by calling Nop on each.

methods.name: StartPreferLocalGrain
methods.description: Ensures a specific grain instantiated with a particular key.

methods.name: SampleLocalGrainEndpoint
methods.description: Samples endpoints from a given stateless worker grain for a specified size.

methods.name: SampleLocalGrainEndpoint
methods.description: Samples endpoints for a specific grain key and sample size.

methods.name: PropagateStatisticsToCluster
methods.description: Forces propagation of environment statistics across the cluster.

methods.name: EnableOverloadDetection
methods.description: Enables or disables overload detection.

methods.name: LatchOverloaded
methods.description: Simulates overload by latching high resource usage statistics.

methods.name: UnlatchOverloaded
methods.description: Resets overload latch to normal state.

methods.name: LatchCpuUsage
methods.description: Simulates high CPU usage for testing overload conditions.

methods.name: UnlatchCpuUsage
methods.description: Resets CPU usage latch to normal.

methods.name: GetLocation
methods.description: Returns this grain's silo address.

methods.name: GetDefaultPlacement
methods.description: Returns the default placement strategy for this grain.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the LocalContentGrain, caching silo identity.

methods.name: GetContent
methods.description: Returns the cached local silo identity content.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Returns the runtime identity string.

methods.name: FetchContentFromLocalGrain
methods.description: Fetches and logs content from the local content grain.
